description: CEO Dashboard: Create the CEO's main dashboard with developer cards and the developer detail view with status management
steps: Create src/app/dashboard/page.tsx - server component that checks user role from Supabase
Create src/components/DeveloperCard.tsx - card component showing developer avatar/photo, name, and submission count
Create src/app/dashboard/ceo/page.tsx - CEO dashboard page with grid of DeveloperCards
Create src/app/dashboard/developer/[id]/page.tsx - CEO view of a specific developer's submissions
Create src/components/SubmissionList.tsx - reusable component for submission lists
Create src/app/api/submissions/[id]/status/route.ts - API route to update submission status
acceptance_criteria: Dashboard page routes CEO to /dashboard/ceo and developer to /dashboard/my-panel
DeveloperCard shows avatar, name, and submission count with hover effects
CEO dashboard shows 4 developer cards in responsive grid
Developer detail page shows submissions with status badges and approve/reject buttons
SubmissionList is reusable with configurable action buttons
StatusBadge renders correct colors for each status
API route validates CEO role before updating submission status
npm run build completes without errors
verification: Run npm run build and confirm successful compilation with zero errors
findings: All CEO dashboard files created successfully. Had to fix the Database type definition - changed interfaces (Profile, Submission, Database) to type aliases because TypeScript interfaces don't get implicit index signatures, causing them to not satisfy Record<string, unknown> which is required by supabase-js v2.110's GenericTable type. Also added Relationships, Views, and Functions fields to the Database type to satisfy GenericSchema. The SubmissionList component is client-side with useState for optimistic status updates via the API route. The API route properly validates CEO role before allowing status changes. Build passes cleanly with no errors. The middleware deprecation warning is pre-existing from FEAT-001.
